Professional Standards & Compliance Training 
Birmingham Law Centre, B4 7ET
Demonstrating thorough understanding of professional conduct rules, ethical obligations, and compliance requirements for legal practitioners in England and Wales.

Core topics covered: SRA Code of Conduct and Professional Standards, Client Confidentiality and Data 
Protection, Conflicts of Interest Management, Anti-Money Laundering Regulations, Professional 
Indemnity and Risk Management, Ethical Decision-Making in Legal Practice

This training meets the mandatory ethics CPD requirements 
set by the Solicitors Regulation Authority (SRA) and is 
approved for professional development credit hours.
Legal Ethics and Professional Responsibility training programme
